The top bandage is on the index finger knuckle, and the second is on the middle finger knuckle. Both bandages feature a bright red backing with white cartoon-like patterns (possibly hearts or characters) and a central orange-brown absorbent pad. The background shows blurred denim fabric, likely jeans.
